hypotheses.claim: Programme-owned journal, revision, body and lineage semantics compose without backend-private identity in durable state.
hypotheses.falsified_if: Any correct replay requires OCCT/Godot/provider object identity or a private ID enters durable evidence.

hypotheses.claim: accepted_pending can be represented as a transaction/reconciliation status without mutating the committed journal until the operation is reconciled and accepted.
hypotheses.falsified_if: The mill scenario requires a partially realized backend object to become durable authority or a failed attempt changes committed history.

hypotheses.claim: Derived state can be discarded and rebuilt from programme authority with the J2 engineering invariant preserved.
hypotheses.falsified_if: A clean replay changes programme status/body mapping/lineage signature for the same fixture and profile.

hypotheses.claim: Process isolation maps provider success/error/crash/timeout into stable statuses without durable-state corruption.
hypotheses.falsified_if: A failed worker mutates authority, escapes containment, or worker identity becomes project meaning.

scenarios.required: journal ingress -> provider adapter -> commit -> replay -> STEP handoff
preserve body:left and body:right with explicit split lineage
discard derived state and independently rebuild the selected revision invariant
error/crash/timeout remain contained and leave durable authority unchanged
Layer A semantic preconditions; inherited automated B/C evidence; explicit Layer-D unqualified state

metrics: STEP layer status and body-selection mode
negative_controls: private TopoDS-style identity injected into durable state must be rejected
pending state submitted to STEP must return RECONCILIATION_UNRESOLVED
unknown or duplicate STEP body selection must be refused
duplicate durable body IDs must be rejected
provider error/crash/timeout must not alter durable authority
